question: Each of R, S, T, U, V, W and X has a duty as a cleaning agent on a different day of a week, starting from Monday to Sunday of the same week. X has duty on a day immediately before U. S and T have duties on one of the days before X. Only W has duty on the day between S and T. V has duty on Tuesday. Who has duty on Monday?
solution:
According to the given statements:

X has duty on a day immediately before U. S and T have duties on one of the days before X. Only W has duty on the day between S and T. V has duty on Tuesday.

1) X has duty on a day immediately before U. 

2) V has duty on Tuesday.
